_meta.com.requstory/summary: Find B2B suppliers by product type, country, prices, minimum order and payment terms; dated facts.

description: Find independent B2B suppliers (wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers) in the Requstory Index to buy goods for a business: catering disposables and packaging, café and coffee supplies, cleaning and janitorial, packaging, fasteners, industrial and growing supplies, in the UK and US. Each result has dated trade facts: prices shown or quote on request (trade login), minimum order (with amount), payment terms, delivery and returns policies, trade account link, and whether an agent could order online. Verified suppliers confirmed their facts and rank first. Then use get_supplier for one supplier's full facts, or request_quote to ask a supplier for a price, stock or a delivery date.

country.description: Keeps suppliers based in this country (two-letter code; UK is read as GB). Most suppliers are in the UK and the US for now. Leave it out to include suppliers from every country in the Index.

limit.description: How many suppliers to return. Verified suppliers come first, then the best matches for the query.

maxMinimumOrder.description: The order size the buyer plans, to leave out suppliers whose stated minimum order is higher. Compared in the supplier's own currency, with no conversion. Suppliers that state no minimum order are kept.

payOnAccount.description: When true, only suppliers that state payment terms (for example 30 days on account). Left out or false, payment terms do not filter the results.

prices.description: Filters by how suppliers publish prices: shown finds suppliers whose prices are on their website, so an agent can compare them; quote finds suppliers who price on request or behind a trade login.

query.description: Product type or supplier name, e.g. "compostable cups", "coffee", "M8 bolts", "janitorial".

verifiedOnly.description: Only suppliers whose owner confirmed the listing.

name: search_suppliers

categories.description: Categories in the Index, to try in "query".

note.description: How to read the facts, or what to try when nothing matched.

canOrderOnline.description: Our AI buyer found a way to order on its website.

category.description: What it supplies, for example "Compostable packaging".

country.description: Two-letter code of the country it is based in, for example GB.

facts.description: Where the facts above come from and how old they are.

checkedAt.description: When the facts were last read (YYYY-MM-DD).

confirmedByOwnerAt.description: When the owner confirmed them (YYYY-MM-DD); null if not verified.

source.description: website (read from its site) or owner (confirmed by the supplier).

minimumOrder.description: Its stated minimum order; null when none was found.

amount.description: The amount read from that text.

currency.description: Currency of the amount: GBP, USD or EUR.

text.description: The minimum order as the supplier states it.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms as stated, for example "30 days on account".

prices.description: Whether a buyer can see prices.

example.description: A price read on its site, as written there.

mode.description: How it shows prices: shown (on the website), quote (on request), trade_login (behind a trade login) or unknown.

profile.description: Requstory company page, when one is published.

recentPrices.description: Prices read on its site or quoted to buyers in the last 60 days, newest first.

date.description: When it was read or quoted (YYYY-MM-DD).

price.description: The price as read or quoted.

source.description: website (read on its site) or owner (quoted by the supplier).

supplier.description: The supplier's website domain, its id in the Index; pass it to get_supplier or request_quote.

track.description: Its record with buyer requests sent through Requstory; null before the first one.

ordersNotArrived.description: Orders buyers said did not arrive.

requestsAnswered.description: Requests answered out of requests sent, for example "3 of 4".

usualAnswerHours.description: Typical hours to answer (the median); null before the first answer.

tradeAccount.description: Link to open a trade account.

verified.description: The owner confirmed the listing and its facts.

title: Search B2B suppliers
